name: coder
description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
one_liner: Lets a company run all its developers' coding setups (and their AI coding agents) on company-controlled servers instead of individual laptops, so nothing sensitive lives on a personal machine.
buyer: A CTO or IT security lead at a mid-size company who needs to onboard developers fast and keep code and API keys off personal laptops for compliance reasons.
business_use_cases: A regulated company (fintech, healthcare) uses it so contractors and new hires never have source code or credentials on their own machines.
An engineering org runs AI coding agents inside company-controlled workspaces with centralized cost tracking and audit logs instead of scattered personal API keys.
A dev-tools consultancy sells 'set up self-hosted cloud dev environments' as a fixed-scope engagement for companies not ready to pay for the commercial version.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting and setup of self-hosted Coder deployments for companies that want control but not the ops burden.
Sell implementation/consulting to configure Terraform templates and AI-agent governance for a client's engineering org.

steal_this: Package a one-day 'secure AI coding agent rollout' consulting offer for a security-conscious startup, using this as the underlying infrastructure.
